title: A first sign-in records the utm_* of the link it came from, through /, /login, the form, the script, the beta queue, Google and the JoomlArt demo banner, and nothing when there is none
steps: S0: From the repo root at the commit under test, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a Postgres the script may create a scratch schema on: node tasks/evidence/sign-in-source/verify.mjs. It builds the real buildApp on 127.0.0.1 (gate off, then on with an aMember stub), captures mail in memory, and drives the installed Google Chrome headless through Playwright.
S1 (script on, gate off): open /?utm_source=joomlart&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tracy-beta-2026-10&utm_content=members-cta, type an address, Continue, type the code from the captured mail.
S2 (script off, gate off): open /?utm_medium=blog&…&utm_content=launch-post-cta, submit the email form, then the six code boxes, as plain form posts.
S3 (gate on): open /new/?inspiration=ja-vega&platform=joomla&utm_medium=demo&…&utm_content=ja-vega, sign in with the code the queue mails.
S4: open / with no utm and sign in.
S5: open /?utm_source=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C%2Fscript%3E&utm_medium=Newsletter&ref=x&next=%2F%2Fevil.invalid and read the address and the hidden fields.

S6 (demo banner, gate off): a page on https://demo.joomlart.com/ja-vega/ (served by Chrome via page.route) carries the banner script as buildWithTracyScript(DEFAULT_SETTING.advert, null) writes it, with data-template=ja-vega and data-origin=<stand>; read the href of the card's Build this site with Tracy button, pass its query to buildUrl from packages/web/tracy-design-page/src/templates.mjs (the Design inspiration Build press), open that /new/ address on the stand and sign in.

Also: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/sign-in-source.test.mjs (22 tests) and apps/tracy-web/test/build-with-tracy-demo.test.mjs with the same TEST_DATABASE_URL; node --test packages/web/tracy-design-page/test/templates.test.mjs.
expect: The script prints verdict PASS checks 25 and writes checks.json beside it.

S1: / lands on /login?<the four utm>; #email-form holds four hidden utm_* inputs; ops_signal has one account.first_sign_in whose data.source is {source:joomlart, medium:email, campaign:tracy-beta-2026-10, content:members-cta}; account.beta_admission->'source' is the same; signalText ends with 'Source: joomlart · email · tracy-beta-2026-10 · members-cta'.
S2: #resend-form on the code step keeps utm_medium=blog; the signal's source.medium is blog and content launch-post-cta.
S3: /login?next= contains the utm; the form reads them out of next; the signal has badge 'JoomlArt member' and source.medium demo.
S4: / goes to a bare /login; no utm_* inputs; the signal has no source key and the message no Source line.
S5: the address after / is exactly ?utm_source=scriptalert1script&utm_medium=other (no ref, no next); the hidden fields hold those values; no dialog opens.

S6: the button href is <stand>/design-inspiration?open=ja-vega&provider=JoomlArt&utm_source=joomlart&utm_medium=demo&utm_campaign=tracy-beta-2026-10&utm_content=ja-vega; buildUrl gives /new/?inspiration=ja-vega&platform=joomla plus the same four utm and no open/provider; /login?next= carries utm_content=ja-vega; #email-form holds utm_medium=demo; the signal's data.source is {source:joomlart, medium:demo, campaign:tracy-beta-2026-10, content:ja-vega}.
node --test: sign-in-source 22/22, build-with-tracy-demo all pass, tracy-design-page templates all pass.

selectors.signal: select data from ops_signal where kind = 'account.first_sign_in'
selectors.account: select beta_admission->'source' from account where email = $1

evidence: 05/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.ai: a signed-out GET /?utm_source=joomlart&utm_medium=email answered 302 to a bare /login, dropping the utm the JoomlArt mail and blog links carry. Branch run: tasks/evidence/sign-in-source/checks.json, s1-login.png, s1-code-step.png, s1-telegram.txt. S6 screenshot: s6-demo-banner.png.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/sign-in-source.js is the only reader and cleaner of utm_* (64 chars, a-z0-9-_., medium in email|blog|demo|site|forum else other); apps/tracy-web/src/workspace/route.js echoes only cleaned utm_* from / to /login; the source rides otp_code.admission, beta_login_job.source and oauth_state.source into account.beta_admission and the account.first_sign_in signal; no cookie is written. The demo banner link (lib/build-with-tracy-demo.js: buildWithTracyHref and the client script, same keys from DEMO_UTM) adds utm_source=joomlart, utm_medium=demo, utm_campaign=tracy-beta-2026-10 and utm_content=<template id>; Design inspiration's buildUrl copies only the four utm_* of its own address onto /new/.
